ArgonTest.Name: Protected abstract trait method
ArgonTest.InputSource:
module _
import Argon.Core::*
trait MyTrait protected proc _.say_hello(): () = abstract
public proc self.run(): () do self.say_hello() end end
instance MyInst: MyTrait public override proc _.say_hello(): () = puts "Hello World" end
proc main(): () do let o = MyInst o.run() end
